page_title: FIO 5-1 ROM | Fiorentina v AS Roma 27/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+2' That's it for today, Simone Sozza has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
90' Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
88' Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
88' The total number of attempts is 20:14.
85' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies well wide of the right post.
83' Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
81' Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
80' Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) cracks a volley from just outside the box, but his miskick goes skyward.
79' Fiorentina take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

78' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the left post. Mile Svilar is alert and denies him with a nice save. Fiorentina will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
75' Raffaele Palladino prepares a substitution. Moise Kean is replaced by Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina).
74' Booking. Moise Kean (Fiorentina) receives a caution from the referee.
74' Here comes a substitution. Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) is brought on as a substitute for Yacine Adli.
73' The resulting corner from Moise Kean (Fiorentina) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
71' 5 - 1 Mats Hummels (AS Roma) scores an unlucky own goal! He deflects a shot into his own net.
70' Corner kick. Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) is ready to send the ball into the box.

70' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the roof of the net, but Mile Svilar shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
69' The linesman signals that Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
69' AS Roma failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
68' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. AS Roma will take a corner kick.
68' Fiorentina can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

68' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) controls the ball from the resulting free kick inside the six-yard box, but his effort is blocked by one of the defending players. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Fiorentina.
67' Substitution. Mats Hummels (AS Roma) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Paulo Dybala walks off.
67' Raffaele Palladino has decided to make a change. Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) replaces Lucas Beltran.
66' Edoardo Bove goes off the pitch and Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) comes on.
65' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) should have been more careful. He commits a bad foul, receives his second yellow card and is sent-off!
64' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Fiorentina comes to nothing.
64' Wow, what an escape. Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. Fiorentina force a corner. They send men into the box.

62' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) takes the free kick from just outside the box and unleashes a fine shot to the left side of the goal, but his effort is thwarted by David de Gea who parries it onto the post.

62' Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Simone Sozza stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. AS Roma win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
61' The yellow card is received by Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina).
61' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 31:69.
60' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Simone Sozza had an easy-decision to make.
58' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
57' Manu Kone (AS Roma) receives a yellow card for infringement.
56' Substitution. Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) has come on for Danilo Cataldi.

55' The opposition back off Moise Kean (Fiorentina), who needs no second invitation to shoot from inside the box. It's a decent effort towards the top right corner, but Mile Svilar denies him with the save.

52' 4 - 1 Andrea Colpani is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Edoardo Bove (Fiorentina) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot into the bottom right corner to make the score 4:1.
50' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
48' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) inside the box.
48' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Simone Sozza saw the whole situation.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Ivan Juric gives a chance to Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) and Gianluca Mancini is off.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Edoardo Bove (Fiorentina) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well wide of the right post.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.

44' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the middle of the target, but David de Gea pulled off a nice save to stop the attempt.
42' The referee shows a yellow card to Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
41' 3 - 1 Goal! Edoardo Bove puts the ball across the area and Moise Kean (Fiorentina) has the easiest task in the world to tuck the ball into an empty net. 3:1.

39' 2 - 1 What a hit that is! Manu Kone (AS Roma) displays his shooting ability as he slams the ball goalwards from distance. His brilliant effort goes towards the bottom right corner and bounces in off the post.
39' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
37' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) makes a strong challenge and Simone Sozza blows for a foul.
36' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to David de Gea, who smothers the ball.
34' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
32' Ivan Juric decides to make a substitution. Angelino will be replaced by Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma).
32' A substitution has been made. Bryan Cristante goes off and Manu Kone (AS Roma) comes on.
31' AS Roma have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
30' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.
30' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
28' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) hits a rasping drive from inside the box after latching onto a lofted pass, but it's straight at Mile Svilar and he makes a comfortable save.
28' The free kick from long range, taken by AS Roma, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
27' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) commits a rough challenge and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul. AS Roma have been awarded a free kick.
26' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) commits a foul and Simone Sozza immediately signals a free kick.
25' That's unlucky! Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
23' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
23' AS Roma exchange some quick one-two passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes in the blink of an eye.
21' Fiorentina take a short corner kick.

21' Danilo Cataldi (Fiorentina) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the right post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out. The referee blows his whistle, Fiorentina are awarded a corner kick.
17' 2 - 0 Goal! Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Mile Svilar into the bottom right corner.
17' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
15' Simone Sozza blows his whistle and signals a foul after Zeki Celik (AS Roma) brought his opponent down. It's a penalty! What an opportunity to score for Fiorentina.
13' Good clearance! Moise Kean (Fiorentina) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.
13' The percentage of ball possession is – 39:61.

9' 1 - 0 Goal! Lucas Beltran displays great vision and sends a pass to Moise Kean (Fiorentina), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 1:0.
7' The AS Roma players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
4' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
2' Simone Sozza has a clear sight and sees a foul from Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina).
